title: TriDot Compliance Drop Alert
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tridot:plan compliance_pct=* phase=*
| timechart span=1w avg(compliance_pct) as avg_compliance by phase
| where avg_compliance<75
description: Alerts when weekly average TriDot plan compliance falls below seventy-five percent for any training phase.
value: Plan compliance drops often mean life stress or injury; catching them early prevents junk miles.
implementation: Export TriDot compliance percentages weekly by `phase` and alert when averages slide under threshold.
visualization: Line chart of weekly compliance by phase with threshold band.
grandmaExplanation: It counts when you stopped following your TriDot plan closely enough to stay on track.
